name: io.github.rastogivaibhav/llm-kosh
description: Local-first AI memory cartridge with temporal causal reasoning. Gives Claude permanent, air-gapped memory across sessions — understands why things happened and in what order, not just keyword search.

environmentVariables.name: CARTRIDGE_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local folder llm-kosh uses as its memory cartridge root. Defaults to ~/.llmkosh/cartridge after running llm-kosh install.
